description.zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒。

> 查询时间的跨度不允许超过90天。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

> The time span of the query cannot exceed 90 days.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS instance.

> Call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS instances.

description.zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写**1**。
description.en: The number of the page to return. For example, to query the first page, set this parameter to **1**.

description.zh: 页面显示的记录数量。最大值：**50**
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **50**.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒。

> 查询时间的跨度不允许超过近90天。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

> The time span of the query cannot exceed 90 days.

descriptions.zh: > 该接口仅适用于DDoS高防（国际）服务。
descriptions.en: > This API operation is available only for the Anti-DDoS Premium service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-defense-records --resource-group-id default --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --start-time 1582992000000 --end-time 1583683200000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
